report.summary: The configured-boot stack overflow is fixed at the source (Wi-Fi/IP handlers now only notify a dedicated mqtt_net task, broker start debounced 1 s after GOT_IP, event-task stack raised to 4 KB) and the display boot-loop is confirmed gone; remaining items are the previously accepted spec deviations plus one info note on REPL stack headroom.

report.dataModel: No Matter/RainMaker model. MQTT: publish {"current_heating_setpoint": "<x.y>"} to zigbee2mqtt/<TRV> (qos1, retain 0); on connect subscribe every TRV/air-sensor topic and publish an empty message to each; {"time": 254} to zigbee2mqtt/bridge/request/permit_join; retained status zerocode/<mac12>/status with last-will. HTTP /settings (GET/POST), /api/state, /api/set.

app_display_init (single setup task, lvgl_port_add_disp_rgb + add_touch, app_display_ready()) + heating_ui_init (waits for ready, builds cards)
app_mqtt_init (mqtt_net task created, handlers registered, NVS config or defaults, STA / onboarding AP)

notes: The configured-boot stack overflow is addressed at the source (handlers notify an mqtt_net task; client starts 1 s after GOT_IP) plus CONFIG_ESP_SYSTEM_EVENT_TASK_STACK_SIZE=4096 in sdkconfig.defaults; not yet confirmed by a boot with stored credentials reaching the console.
The product's console REPL is 8 KB on this target; a command handler running in the REPL also runs on that stack, no REPL-stack headroom is configured.
No factory state on a built image: mqtt_load_config() seeds 'free4all' and the default broker when nothing is stored, so a bare panel is already 'configured'.
Default broker is plain mqtt://homeassistant.gdenu.fi:1883; TRV poll publishes an empty payload to command-bearing state topics.
Factory reset is a 10 s single-button hold.
Voice vocabulary holds three numbers per room; the spec's 'set the office to 21' has no phrase.

peripherals.driver: app_display (single setup task, lvgl_port_add_disp_rgb + add_touch, app_display_ready())
app_audio (AFE + MultiNet) on app_dsp_shim's generic dot product
app_mqtt (mqtt_net task for Wi-Fi/IP work, STA / onboarding SoftAP, CA in NVS, state-request poll)

findings.description: The console REPL is configured with an 8 KB stack on this target (non-USB-JTAG console) but the project sets no REPL-stack headroom, while the product keeps product-lifetime state (3 esp_timers, s_combo, s_listen_timer) across commands and the 'heating' command runs heating_clamp_tenth and a full lookup on it; the header (app_console.h) explicitly says standby support is required for the non-default REPL stack.
findings.evidence: firmware/components/app_console/include/app_console.h:1-30 (REPL stack/standby note); app_logic.cpp 'heating' command body; no CONFIG_ESP_CONSOLE_*_STACK or standby symbols in sdkconfig.defaults.
findings.failureScenario: A user runs `heating set 0 21.5` shortly after the boot with the audio/AFE and MQTT tasks alive: the REPL task's default 8 KB is shared with the command handler's locals, and a stack overflow there panics the panel the same way sys_evt did — no headroom is configured and nothing bounds it.
findings.suggestedChange: Size the REPL explicitly (CONFIG_ESP_CONSOLE_* REPL stack/standby) or keep command handlers' locals small and off the audio task paths.

findings.description: Voice vocabulary still holds three numbers per room (20, 21.5, 21-and-a-half) — 17 phrases at runtime. The spec's own example 'set the office to 21' has no phrase, so that sentence ends in 'Sorry, not understood'.
findings.evidence: heating_voice.cpp k_variant_tenth = {200, 215, 210}; the functional report's '17 of 17 English phrases registered'.
findings.failureScenario: A user following the spec says 'set the office to 21': nothing in MultiNet's list matches, nothing is published.
findings.suggestedChange: Add 21 (and ideally every whole degree in the panel's range) as variants if MultiNet's phrase budget allows, or document the limit as a deviation.
